output.reason: [ev-10a72c580d6b] shows that in 0.16.0 the externalsecrets.external-secrets.io CRD's v1beta1 version stops being the storage version (storage: true → false). The change text says existing objects stay stored as v1beta1 until they are rewritten, and that status.storedVersions must be updated. So exposure depends on what is stored in the cluster, not on which apiVersion the manifests use. The proposed gvk-in-use v1beta1 condition is too broad, because it flags manifests written as v1beta1 even when nothing is stored as v1beta1. It is also too narrow, because it misses clusters whose manifests already use v1 but whose objects are still stored as v1beta1. The canonical CRD storedVersions condition captures exactly the clusters that are exposed.

correction.statement: Storage version of externalsecrets.external-secrets.io changes v1beta1 → v1. The exposed environments are those where the CRD's status.storedVersions still lists v1beta1. Those ExternalSecret objects must be rewritten and storedVersions updated before a later release removes v1beta1.
